name: dns-leading-dot-excluded-apex-valid
description: A leading-dot DNS excluded subtree is treated as a subdomain-only suffix by the validators that accept leading-dot DNS constraints. The excluded subtree .example.com rejects names below the apex, but it must not reject the apex name example.com itself.
notes: The corpus already covers the permittedSubtrees leading-dot apex boundary. This excludedSubtrees variant catches code that implements excluded suffix matching as a raw string has-suffix test and rejects the apex by mistake.
